<thought>We need a template that matches an SN2 substitution where an alkyl halide is replaced by a secondary amine. Using the available functional group names, we can search for templates that break an “alkyl halide” and form a “secondary amines”. No bond specifications are needed.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["alkyl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["secondary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
